$comment: Provenance of every numeric threshold an executor applies when the world model does not declare it. Values with spec_source null have NO basis in the SKILL.md and are design heuristics. architecture/tests/threshold_sync.test.js checks that executors output these values and that each spec_source still appears in its SKILL.md. Distinct from architecture/calibration.defaults.json, which holds calibration records.

dominance_damage_ratio.derivation: no basis in SKILL.md. Numerically equal to the example k_punish = 1.5, but not derived from it.

hurtbox_exposure_ratio.derivation: no basis in SKILL.md. Design heuristic; a project should declare its own value.

spec_source.derivation: upper bound of the heuristic meso-loop band [2 min, 15 min], in seconds. The skill does NOT define a drought rule; this default is a choice made from that band.

excessive_retention_threshold.derivation: no basis in SKILL.md. Design heuristic; a project should declare its own value.

spec_source.derivation: example floor in the skill, which the skill itself says is project-specific and not a target to maximize.
